phase_name: Non-blocking advisory in the conversion quality gate

objectives.description: Enumerate stderr consumers, add live-heredoc import, defensive metadata read in run_quality_gate, print ADVISORY line, comment prohibitions
objectives.note: Stderr-consumer sweep: literature-ingest.sh greps only 'QUALITY GATE FAILED' and 'NO TEXT LAYER:'; literature-ingest-online.sh does not grep convert stderr directly (delegates to literature-ingest.sh); test-literature-convert.sh greps distinct markers (control-character, printable-ratio, sentence-boundary-glue, NO TEXT LAYER:, LITERATURE_CONVERTER=ocr). None can fire on the ADVISORY: token. Manual smoke test (synthetic PDFs with real text layers, scan vs pdfTeX metadata) confirmed: scan-metadata PDF exits 0 with one ADVISORY line and no .rejected; clean PDF exits 0 with zero ADVISORY lines; Quality gate: PASSED printed in both cases.
